mapper.insert: insert into post(user_id, post_tag_id, content_delta, title, plain_text, word_count, cover, visibility) value(#{userId}, #{postTagId}, #{contentDelta}, #{title}, #{plainText}, #{wordCount}, #{cover}, #{visibility})
mapper.update: update post set like_count = like_count + 1 where id=#{id}
update post set like_count = like_count - 1 where id=#{id}
update post set comment_count = comment_count + 1 where id=#{id}
update post set comment_count = comment_count - 1 where id=#{id}
